content:
Hey, I’m Vishnu. I work on AI-native infrastructure, mostly living in Kubernetes, airgapped enterprise deployments, and GPU clusters. This blog is where I’ll write up the stuff I actually run into: SUSE/Rancher setups, vLLM experiments, homelab GPU testing, and whatever infra problem I’m currently knee-deep in.
No fixed schedule, no polish guarantee. Just notes from the trenches, mostly so future-me (and maybe you) doesn’t have to re-solve the same problem twice.
More soon.
